description: Resolves the one hypothesis qou-y3bm left open, with a NEGATIVE: Delta^{(n)} is NOT level-independent. prop:brane-tower-q-laplacian-decay Step 3 is an EQUALITY, |<e_k, Delta^{(n)} e_k>| = (lambda_k)^n, so Delta^{(n)} is the n-th ITERATE of the q-Laplacian. The tower is therefore geometric in hbar_q^2*lambda_k and sums to 1/(1 - hbar_q^2*lambda_k); the implemented 1/(1 - hbar_q^2) is the lambda_k = 1 member, which pins L_q = sqrt(hbar_q). L_q is a FREE geometric scale, so qbeta_e0.tower_summed does carry a hidden parameter -- now named and priced.
